description: Real-world noise: pleasantries, signature block, and a quoted prior thread. A single valid request is buried inside. Extraction must ignore the noise.

input.subject: RE: catching up + a quick quote
input.body:
Hi team,

Great to see you at the Rotterdam expo last week! Hope the trip back was smooth.

Quick one: can you quote 1 x 40HC of machinery parts from Rotterdam to New York, FOB, ready around 20 June?

Thanks so much,
Sophie

Sophie Meijer | Procurement Lead
Harbour Trade BV | +31 10 123 4567

-----Original Message-----
From: Linkport Forwarders
Subject: Newsletter - June sailings
> Our June trans-Atlantic schedule is now open. Reply to this address for rates.
> Standard transit Rotterdam-New York remains approximately 12-14 days.

expected.notes: all_in = 1 x (2550+860)+110 = 3520. Must extract from the live request, not the quoted newsletter thread.
